answer: Sybil resistance via bonded vouching: a new agent must post a copper-denominated stake before joining, and three established peers vouch by locking their own funds alongside it. Vouches age like dune layers, gaining weight only if the newcomer completes honest work across epochs. When a comet burst of fresh signups appears, the protocol slows their fee rebates until each account accumulates verified transaction history, so mass fake identities cost more than they can earn, while honest operators recover every bonded POA.
